text:
Noah (product): Heads-up: we9re GA-ing Hosted Realtime Tool Calling tomorrow 08:00 UTC. This includes the new /v1/realtime/toolcall endpoint and mosaic-{lite,standard,pro} model tiers.
Priya (eng-runtime): Clients: please add header x-rw-realtime: v1 and prefer the new endpoint. SDKs will proxy old calls for 14 days but migration is recommended.
Lina (devex): Will publish a short migration guide + 2-line examples for JS/Python.
Tess (support): Policy note: default org concurrent streams = 150. Overages get soft-throttled; quota requests via support form. Preparing canned responses.
Sam (eng-sre): Rollout plan: canary us-west-2 -> 24h monitor -> eu-west-1 -> 72h global. Watch metrics: active_streams_per_org, 95p stream latency, token-controller CPU. Alert thresholds: 95p > 250ms or active_streams > 120% quota.
Priya (eng-runtime): Known caveats: some legacy model builds won't support structured tool outputs and will return 422. Also initial KV warmup can spike CPU briefly.
Lina (devex): Quick curl example to validate: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "x-rw-realtime: v1" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-standard","tools":[{"name":"search","schema":{}}],"prompt":"find docs"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/toolcall
```
deploy-bot: Deploy started: realtime-toolcall-ga -> canary us-west-2 at 1865001500 by Priya (eng-runtime)
Priya (eng-runtime): Canary finished at 1865001650, smoke tests green. Monitoring dashboard up.
Tess (support): Notifying top alpha customers now and scheduling a migration webinar.
Noah (product): Thanks. If you own SDKs/docs/support flows please reply in-thread with your name so we can track owners. :rocket:
